meta.title: Protomaps Basemap tiles — free, no API key
meta.description: Free vector map tiles of the Protomaps Basemap, z0 to z15, served as a PMTiles archive. No API key, no rate limit, no service level guarantee. A drop-in replacement for blocked OpenStreetMap raster tiles in Leaflet and MapLibre.
ui.zoomTitle: zoom {zoom}. The archive holds z0 to z15, and a layer that starts above this one draws nothing.
